Experience with Python, SQL, APIs, data pipelines, MLOps, automation and modern software delivery practices. This includes foundations, buildings, trenches, duct banks, roads, drainage, structural steel, cable routing infrastructure, boundary walls, and all site development works related to civil scope. The role ensures full compliance with IFC drawings, civil specifications, geotechnical recommendations, structural standards, QA/QC requirements, and international codes and Egyptian local codes. Key Accountabilities Civil & Structural Construction Oversight Monitor and inspection for EPC execution of all civil works including: Foundations for GIS/AIS, transformers, MV buildings, BESS civil works, O&M building, all finishing works Cable trenches, duct banks, manholes, pull pits Substation control building (structural + architectural) Roads, paving, fencing, gates Drainage systems & stormwater network Equipment plinths and steel support structures Verify works comply with IFC drawings, technical specs, and approved method statements. Ensure workmanship meets structural tolerance, alignment, and level requirements. Geotechnical & Earthworks Control Review and monitor excavation, backfilling, compaction, and soil replacement. Ensure compliance with geotechnical reports (bearing capacity, groundwater considerations, soil treatment). Witness field density tests, compaction tests, plate load tests, and verify results. Ensure EPC manages soil disposal and backfill materials properly. Concrete & Reinforcement Quality Assurance Witness concrete works: batching, slump tests, cube/cylinder tests, temperature checks. Inspect reinforcement installation, bar spacing, anchorage, lap lengths, and supports. Verify formwork quality, alignment, shuttering, and curing compliance. Monitor concrete pouring sequence and vibration practices. Civil Engineering Review & Technical Comments Review EPC submittals including: Civil shop drawings QA/QC documents checklist, FAT, FQP, and ITP Structural calculations Bar Bending Schedules (BBS) Method statements Material approvals Provide structured, technically sound comments aligned with codes and project requirements. Review the Engineering documents and aligned with the Back-office engineering team to be aligned with the project specifications. Lead the technical discussion physically or virtual meetings with the EPC, client and OEMs and other stakeholders. Interface Coordination Coordinate civil interfaces with: Electrical (trench routing, foundation openings, embedded conduits, earthing) Firefighting BESS systems (HVAC, equipment rooms, enclosures) SCADA/telecom ducting Prevent clashes through early detection and collaborative resolution with OE team.
